notes:
# Waymark 0.5.7

- Added direct Empyrean Trace achievement updates. Supported pickups mark the matching trace for the detected character without requiring an open game map, a terrain match or a position estimate.
- Added restoration of supported previously collected traces during character entry. Login snapshots are held until their entity, server and character name match the verified world-entry identity; a saved planning profile is never used as proof.
- Repeated events are idempotent. Zero/missing entries do not erase existing completion, and character/server changes cannot reuse another character's snapshot.
- Large login restorations save in one transaction to keep the reader responsive. Connection diagnostics distinguish restored login records, live trace updates and the visual-map fallback.
- The reviewed achievement-to-marker crosswalk covers 544 Verteron, 547 Altgard and 190 Abyss reference locations. Ambiguous, missing or inconsistent catalog matches remain excluded; checked Verteron map icons and manual marks remain available for other references.
- Automatic farm recommendations now skip pets identified by recent current-session soul pickups. Nearby unfinished alternatives are suggested, including when most pets are complete. Explicit unfinished targets stay selected.
- Completed Lv.3 pets are excluded even when stale ownership/estimate fields disagree; completed targets are also suppressed in map/minimap captions.
- After updating, enter your character once with Waymark running. Map checks are no longer required for supported network trace updates.

Validation: 242 worker tests, 151 frontend tests and TypeScript checks pass. Both saved login recordings replay through real message framing and restore mapped completion without map/position input. A fresh controlled pickup matched its exact achievement and map reference. The diagnostic did not write production progress; final installed-app end-to-end confirmation remains separate.
